basics.label: Senior Product Manager | Revenue Cycle Management | Healthcare Technology
basics.summary: Healthcare RCM and product/solutions leader with 12+ years across U.S. medical billing, revenue-cycle operations, healthcare technology, business analysis, analytics, automation, implementation, and workflow transformation. Brings 6+ years of progressively senior product-management-equivalent responsibility translating payer requirements, client feedback, operational pain points, data patterns, and regulatory considerations into requirements, priorities, user stories, acceptance criteria, implementation plans, success metrics, and scalable healthcare capabilities.
